name: Darkvision
levelText: alchemist 2, antipaladin 2, arcanist 2, hunter 3, investigator 2, medium 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, ranger 3, redmantisassassin 2, sorcerer 2, wizard 2
componentsText: V, S, M (either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate)
description:
The subject gains the ability to see 60 feet even in total darkness. Darkvision is black and white only but otherwise like normal sight.

Darkvision can be made permanent with a permanency spell.
